notes: No shared edits beyond the two registry lines. Sizes reuse packages/avfilter/src/activation/integer-option.ts.
Linux-gated float cases: none. The amount float is converted to an integer once at parse time; the kernel is integer and exact in JavaScript numbers.
The spec's '23x23 with tiny planes' is refused natively (scalebits 44 > 25), so it is covered as an error-parity case; 23x3 and 3x23 (scalebits 24) run on tiny planes instead.

Two refusals have no native output to compare: short frames (h < 4*(ly/2), native leaves the output unwritten) and nonzero alpha amounts on yuva420p (native SIGSEGV). Both were probed against the sandbox reference.
Environment: sandbox Node was v22; bootstrap requires Node 24, so /opt/node24 (v24.22.3) was used.

Setup durations: bootstrap (npm 10 s, submodule 8 s, reference build) 225 s total; baseline typecheck, lint, boundaries and the registry test 62 s, all green. The differential file runs in about 40 s on 4 vCPUs.
